error-label.description: Message shown if playback cannot start or the recording fails to load.

mute-label.description: Accessible name of the mute button.

pause-label.description: Accessible name of the pause button.

play-label.description: Accessible name of the play button.

rates.description: Comma-separated playback speeds between 0.25 and 4. Normal speed (1) is always available.

seek-label.description: Accessible name of the timeline slider.

speed-label.description: Accessible label for the playback-rate picker.

src.description: Source URL for the recording. Use an HTTP(S) URL or a relative URL.

time-label.description: Accessible time template. Keep the {elapsed} and {duration} placeholders.

title.description: Visible title and accessible name of the player.

transcript-href.description: URL for the recording's text transcript. Use an HTTP(S) URL or a relative URL.

unmute-label.description: Accessible name of the unmute button.

--ki-audio-backdrop-filter.description: Complete backdrop filter applied to the player, off by default.

--ki-audio-bg.description: Background behind the player and transcript link.

--ki-audio-bg-image.description: Optional image painted over the player background.

--ki-audio-progress-bg.description: Colour of the elapsed timeline and seek thumb.

--ki-audio-radius.description: Corner radius of the player panel.

--ki-audio-speed-radius.description: Corner radius of the playback speed button.

--ki-audio-title-family.description: Font family of the recording title.

--ki-button-ghost-neutral-disabled-borde.description: color used by the button component for ghost neutral disabled border.

--ki-button-ghost-neutral-hover-border.description: color used by the button component for ghost neutral hover border.

--ki-button-ghost-neutral-rest-border.description: color used by the button component for ghost neutral rest border.

--ki-button-primary-neutral-disabled-bg.description: color used by the button component for primary neutral disabled background. Deliberate deviation: Figma disabled is Surface/disabled_base_em gray.100 with gray.400 text (≈1.4:1); Kimen keeps gray.200 for contrast (precedent 010 D2, pending founder ratification).

--ki-button-primary-neutral-disabled-bor.description: color used by the button component for primary neutral disabled border.

--ki-button-primary-neutral-disabled-fg.description: color used by the button component for primary neutral disabled foreground. Deliberate deviation: Figma disabled text is text/base_em gray.400 (≈1.4:1 on gray.100); Kimen keeps text.muted gray.700 for readable disabled text (precedent 010 D2, pending founder ratification).

--ki-button-primary-neutral-hover-bg.description: color used by the button component for primary neutral hover background (MarsUI: rest fill; hover lightening comes from the hover overlay).

--ki-button-primary-neutral-hover-border.description: color used by the button component for primary neutral hover border (MarsUI top/inline edge; none in onmars v2).

--ki-button-primary-neutral-hover-fg.description: color used by the button component for primary neutral hover foreground.

--ki-button-primary-neutral-rest-bg.description: color used by the button component for primary neutral rest background (MarsUI Surface/primary_med_em, brand 500).

--ki-button-primary-neutral-rest-border.description: color used by the button component for primary neutral rest border (MarsUI top/inline edge; none in onmars v2).

--ki-button-primary-neutral-rest-fg.description: color used by the button component for primary neutral rest foreground.

--ki-button-quaternary-neutral-disabled-.description: color used by the button component for quaternary neutral disabled background.

color used by the button component for quaternary neutral disabled foreground: the disabled ink of every field and selection control (Text/base_em). quaternary has no fill or border, so its ink alone shows the state; ki.text.muted equals its resting ki.text.med-em in onmars.

--ki-button-quaternary-neutral-hover-bg.description: color used by the button component for quaternary neutral hover background (MarsUI hover mechanism: hover-overlay-inverse Black/3 wash over the transparent rest fill).

--ki-button-quaternary-neutral-hover-fg.description: color used by the button component for quaternary neutral hover foreground (MarsUI quaternary label text/med_em gray; never the accent).

--ki-button-quaternary-neutral-rest-bg.description: color used by the button component for quaternary neutral rest background.

--ki-button-quaternary-neutral-rest-fg.description: color used by the button component for quaternary neutral rest foreground (MarsUI quaternary label text/med_em gray; never the accent).

--ki-control-border-width.description: Stroke width of the boundary of a compact control.

--ki-control-radius-track.description: Corner radius of a track containing adjacent controls.

--ki-control-size-md.description: Medium control track height, 40 CSS px at the default root size.

--ki-control-size-sm.description: Small control track height, 32 CSS px at the default root size.

--ki-corner-activity-mark.description: Round corners for rings and typing dots.

--ki-corner-inline.description: Small radius for an outline around inline content.

--ki-density-target-min.description: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).

--ki-focus-ring-color.description: Colour of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws: 3:1 or more against the page in every theme and scheme.

--ki-focus-ring-offset.description: Gap between a focusable component and its keyboard focus ring.

--ki-focus-ring-width.description: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws (its outline). One token instead of one per component, so a mode or a theme changes every ring at once.

--ki-glyph-size-md.description: Medium glyph for body content (20px at the default root size).

--ki-glyph-size-sm.description: Small glyph for dense layouts (16px at the default root size).

--ki-media-layout-inline-max.description: Maximum inline size of a self-contained media control panel.

--ki-scale-control-coarse-target.description: Minimum grip target when a value scale has a coarse primary pointer.

--ki-scale-control-track-height.description: Thickness of the inactive rail of a value scale.

--ki-spacing-action-inset.description: Interior space at the edge of an action surface or divider.

--ki-spacing-block.description: Deprecated alias kept for pre-Fase-1 consumers; use ki.space.xl.

--ki-spacing-media-caption.description: Block spacing between a media frame and its caption.

--ki-typography-family-body.description: semantic font family for typography family body.

--ki-typography-line-height-body-1.description: semantic dimension for typography line height body 1.

--ki-typography-line-height-caption-2.description: semantic dimension for typography line height caption 2.

--ki-typography-size-body-1.description: semantic dimension for typography size body 1.

--ki-typography-size-caption-2.description: semantic dimension for typography size caption 2.

--ki-typography-underline-offset.description: Gap between text and its underline.

--ki-typography-underline-thickness.description: Stroke width of a resting text underline.

--ki-typography-weight-body-medium.description: semantic font weight for typography weight body medium.

component.description:
A recording player with play, pause, a seek timeline, elapsed and total time,
playback speed, mute, and an optional transcript link.

ended.description: Forwarded when the recording ends. The catalog can bind a declared action here.

play.description: Forwarded when the native playback state switches to playing.

timeupdate.description: Forwarded when the native playback position is updated.

player.description: The named group and themed surface.

progress.description: Played portion of the timeline rail.

audioTitle.description: Visible title and accessible name of the player.

errorLabel.description: Message shown if playback cannot start or the recording fails to load.

muteLabel.description: Accessible name of the mute button.

pauseLabel.description: Accessible name of the pause button.

playLabel.description: Accessible name of the play button.

rates.description: Comma-separated playback speeds between 0.25 and 4. Normal speed (1) is always available.

seekLabel.description: Accessible name of the timeline slider.

speedLabel.description: Accessible label for the playback-rate picker.

src.description: Source URL for the recording. Use an HTTP(S) URL or a relative URL.

timeLabel.description: Accessible time template. Keep the {elapsed} and {duration} placeholders.

transcriptHref.description: URL for the recording's text transcript. Use an HTTP(S) URL or a relative URL.

unmuteLabel.description: Accessible name of the unmute button.
